issues.reason: 'Rule premises bind through plain variables. A premise never contains a Skolem term: (sk_<verb> $x) function terms belong to conclusions' — the premise's (sk_block $c) terms can match no asserted blocking, so the rule can never fire.

The named obliques apply only when the PP answers where/when/how/whence/whither; 'blocked from the north wind' names what is warded off, not the blocking's origin, so it takes the preposition-named oblique (From e north_wind) and Source asserts a whence the sentence does not state.

What stands: no stated form nests a per-member distribution rule with its own variable inside another rule's mintable conclusion, and a licensed flat form exists (range the lanterns in the premise — (Member $l lantern) (LocatedIn $l $c) — the relational-universal/donkey route with a per-binding state (sk_lit $e $l)); what is overstated: the instruction set states no explicit bar, and the nested rule is well-typed and asserts nothing false, so on its own it is unlicensed improvisation rather than a violated rule.

gaps_confirmed: A definite plural introduced inside a rule's consequent ('the lanterns in that cove') whose distributive predicate must reach each member: the group-witness + (PartOf $x <group>) distribution form has no licensed placement inside a consequent; only the flat premise-range (donkey / forall-forall) approximation is licensed, and it drops the definite group witness.

Durative 'through <period>' ('stay lit through winter'): During is restricted to during/while/throughout with a reified outer eventuality and no Start/End term covers a whole season, so the extent is carried only by the surface oblique (Through e winter) — the parse's (Time e winter) under-specifies the whole-period reading without misstating it.
defect_summary: Issue 0: bind the blocking through a plain event variable in the premise — (Member $c cove) (Member $e block) (Theme $e $c) (Agent $e cliff_spire) — and key the lit state on it, (sk_lit $e ...), with (During (sk_lit ...) $e). Issue 1: replace (Source $e north_wind) with the preposition-named oblique (From $e north_wind). Issue 2 (partial): flatten the per-lantern content into the same rule by adding (Member $l lantern) (LocatedIn $l $c) to the premise and minting (sk_lit $e $l) with its Still, Time and flat (Member $l lit) atoms in the consequent; no licensed form places the definite lantern group's own distribution rule inside the consequent (gap above).
notes: The compound decompositions and the stay-lit continuation shape (reified state + Still + flat atom, no tense) are correct. 'The north wind' (an article, hence a witness by the oblique-NP rule) and bare-plural 'cliff-spires' as bare-kind fillers are borderline inside a generic rule and were not raised as issues.
